function showWallInventory(){const sc=getScene();if(!sc)return;mode='menu';sc.menuShell('WALL DECORATIONS','MOVE, STORE OR SELL YOUR WALL ITEMS.',()=>showInventoryRoot());const entries=[{id:'__native-board',placed:true,native:true},...placed.map(o=>({id:o.id,uid:o.uid,placed:true})),...owned.map((id,index)=>({id,index,placed:false}))].filter(o=>o.native||lookup(o.id));const pages=Math.max(1,Math.ceil(entries.length/4));page=Math.max(0,Math.min(page,pages-1));entries.slice(page*4,page*4+4).forEach((o,i)=>{const item=o.native?{name:'Bulletin Board'}:lookup(o.id),y=92+i*31,name=item.name.replace(/^Flag /,'').replace(/ Source$/,'').slice(0,17);btn(sc,name,84,y,147,27,()=>{},true);if(o.native){btn(sc,'MOVE',238,y,100,27,()=>sc.beginGaragePlacement('board'));return;}if(o.placed){btn(sc,'MOVE',238,y,48,27,()=>moveItem(o.uid));btn(sc,'STORE',290,y,48,27,()=>storeItem(o.uid));}else{btn(sc,'PLACE',238,y,100,27,()=>{owned.splice(o.index,1);save();beginPlacement(o.id)})}btn(sc,'SELL',343,y,51,27,()=>{if(o.placed){const j=placed.findIndex(v=>v.uid===o.uid);if(j>=0)placed.splice(j,1)}else{const j=owned.indexOf(o.id);if(j>=0)owned.splice(j,1)}save();redraw();if(sc.saveData){sc.saveData.money+=25;sc.persist?.();sc.refresh?.()}showWallInventory()})});if(!entries.length)btn(sc,'NO WALL DECORATIONS',84,112,310,30,()=>{},true);btn(sc,'PREV',84,217,83,25,()=>{page--;showWallInventory()},page===0);btn(sc,'PAGE '+(page+1)+'/'+pages,174,217,132,25,()=>{},true);btn(sc,'NEXT',314,217,80,25,()=>{page++;showWallInventory()},page===pages-1);sc.furniturePanel.setVisible(true)}

function removeGhost(){if(ghost?.active)ghost.destroy();ghost=null}
function beginPlacement(id){const sc=getScene(),item=lookup(id);if(!sc||!item)return;window.__ccWallDecorPlacing=true;if(!owned.includes(id)){owned.push(id);save()};pending=id;mode='placing';sc.furniturePanel.setVisible(false);removeGhost();ghost=sc.add.rectangle(240,55,item.w,item.h,0x7bd3b4,.35).setStrokeStyle(2,0xe5f3da,.9).setDepth(12).setVisible(false);sc.say('Move cursor over the wall. Click to place; Esc to cancel.')}
function position(pointer,item){const x=pointer.worldX,y=pointer.worldY;const xx=Math.round(Math.max(item.w/2,Math.min(480-item.w/2,x))),yy=Math.round(Math.max(5+item.h/2,Math.min(91-item.h/2,y)));const left=xx-item.w/2,right=xx+item.w/2,top=yy-item.h/2,bottom=yy+item.h/2;const intersects=(a,b,c,d)=>right>a&&left<b&&bottom>c&&top<d;return {x:xx,y:yy,valid:y>=5+item.h/2&&y<=91-item.h/2&&!intersects(120,201,26,97)&&!intersects(297,330,29,97)&&!intersects(341,431,23,97)&&!placed.some(o=>{const b=lookup(o.id);return b&&Math.abs(o.x-xx)<(item.w+b.w)/2+3&&Math.abs(o.y-yy)<(item.h+b.h)/2+3})}}
function move(pointer){if(mode!=='placing'||!pending||!ghost)return;const p=position(pointer,lookup(pending));ghost.setPosition(p.x,p.y).setVisible(true).setFillStyle(p.valid?0x7bd3b4:0xe08070,p.valid?.35:.2).setStrokeStyle(2,p.valid?0xe5f3da:0xffaaaa,.9)}

Open Build to move or store it.')}

const approvedBrick=new Image();approvedBrick.src='data:image/png;base64,';
function addApprovedWallRow(sc){
 if(sc.__ccApprovedWallRow||!approvedBrick.complete)return;
 sc.__ccApprovedWallRow=true;
 if(!sc.textures.exists('cc-approved-brick-row'))sc.textures.addImage('cc-approved-brick-row',approvedBrick);
 for(let x=0;x<480;x+=48){
  sc.add.image(x,18,'cc-approved-brick-row').setOrigin(0,0).setDisplaySize(48,17).setCrop(0,0,48,17).setDepth(0.2);

     sc.__ccNativeOpenFurniture=sc.openFurniture;
     sc.openFurniture=function(which,...args){if(which==='inventory'){showInventoryRoot();return}return this.__ccNativeOpenFurniture.call(this,which,...args)};
   }sc.input.on('pointermove',move);sc.input.on('pointerdown',place);sc.events.once('shutdown',()=>{if(sceneRef===sc)sceneRef=null;removeGhost();sprites=[];spriteScene=null;redrawTicket++});redraw()}
setInterval(bind,250);
let swallowWallPlacementClick=false;
document.addEventListener('pointerdown',e=>{
 if(mode!=='placing'||!pending||e.target!==window.CC_GAME?.canvas)return;
 swallowWallPlacementClick=true;
 const rect=window.CC_GAME.canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
 const pointer={worldX:(e.clientX-rect.left)*480/rect.width,worldY:(e.clientY-rect.top)*330/rect.height};
 place(pointer);
 e.preventDefault();e.stopImmediatePropagation();
},true);

  e.preventDefault();e.stopImmediatePropagation();

 },true);

<script>window.__ccNov13Assets={"garage-mounted-jump-rope": "data:image/png;base64,"};</script>
<script>
(function(){
'use strict';
const STORAGE='cc-gym-extra-gear-nov13-v1';
const NAMES={0:'Heavy Bag',1:'Thai Pads',2:'Speed Bag',3:'Jump Rope',5:'Kettlebells',8:'Focus Mitts',9:'Dumbbells',10:'Freestanding Bag',14:'Resistance Bands'};
const PRICE={0:65,1:90,2:70,3:35,5:75,8:55,9:45,10:80,14:45};
const STAT={0:0,1:0,2:1,3:3,5:3,8:1,9:2,10:0,14:2};
const STAT_NAME=['STRIKING','SPEED','STRENGTH','CONDITIONING'];
const WALL=new Set([1,3,8,14]);
const ART={0:'approved-garage-heavy-bag',1:'approved-garage-garage-thai-pads',2:'approved-garage-garage-speed-bag',3:'garage-mounted-jump-rope',5:'approved-garage-kettlebells',8:'approved-garage-garage-focus-mitts',9:'approved-garage-dumbbells',10:'approved-garage-freestanding-bag',14:'approved-garage-bands'};
const POSE={0:'bag',2:'bag',5:'lift',9:'lift',10:'bag'};
let placing=null,ghost=null;
const scene=()=>window.CC_GAME?.scene?.scenes?.find(s=>s.sys?.isActive?.()&&s.furniturePanel&&s.openTrainingBoard);
function copies(sc){return sc.saveData.extraGear??(sc.saveData.extraGear=[])}
function store(sc){try{localStorage.setItem(STORAGE,JSON.stringify(copies(sc)))}catch(e){}sc.persist?.()}
function cleanGhost(){if(ghost?.active)ghost.destroy();ghost=null}
function button(sc,text,x,y,w,h,fn,disabled=false){sc.panelButton(sc.furniturePanel,text,x,y,w,h,fn,disabled,disabled?0x314448:0x42646b)}
function count(sc,i){return Number(sc.saveData.ownedGear?.[i]===true)+copies(sc).filter(o=>o.i===i).length}
function bounds(sc,i){const b=sc.gearBounds(i);return {rx:Math.max(8,b.rx||12),ry:Math.max(5,b.ry||9)}}
function spriteSize(sc,i){const size=sc.garageGearArtSize(i),wall=WALL.has(i);return {w:Math.min(wall?30:38,size.w),h:Math.min(wall?30:42,size.h)}}
function valid(sc,obj,x,y){
 if(sc.gymLevel()!==1)return false;
 const w=WALL.has(obj.i),b=bounds(sc,obj.i),sz=spriteSize(sc,obj.i);
 if(w){if(x<sz.w/2+5||x>480-sz.w/2-5||y<sz.h/2+7||y>94-sz.h/2)return false;
  if(!sc.garageWallClear({x:x-sz.w/2,y:y-sz.h/2,w:sz.w,h:sz.h},-1))return false;
  return !copies(sc).some(o=>o!==obj&&!o.stored&&WALL.has(o.i)&&Math.abs(o.x-x)<(spriteSize(sc,o.i).w+sz.w)/2+4&&Math.abs(o.y-y)<(spriteSize(sc,o.i).h+sz.h)/2+4);
 }
 return sc.validPlacement(x,y,b.rx,b.ry,-1,-1);
}
function cancel(){const sc=scene();if(!placing)return;placing.obj.stored=placing.wasStored;placing=null;cleanGhost();if(sc){sc.drawEquipment();store(sc);sc.say('Placement cancelled.')}}
function beginPlace(sc,obj){if(placing)cancel();const wasStored=obj.stored;obj.stored=true;placing={obj,wasStored};sc.furniturePanel.setVisible(false);sc.rosterPanel.setVisible(false);cleanGhost();const w=WALL.has(obj.i),sz=spriteSize(sc,obj.i),b=bounds(sc,obj.i);
 ghost=sc.add.rectangle(obj.x||250,obj.y||(w?55:190),w?sz.w:b.rx*2,w?sz.h:b.ry*2,0x80c4a0,.24).setStrokeStyle(1,0xdff2d2).setDepth(80);
 sc.drawEquipment();sc.say('Click a clear '+(w?'wall':'floor')+' spot to place '+NAMES[obj.i]+'. Esc cancels.');}
function placeAt(sc,x,y){if(!placing)return false;const obj=placing.obj;x=Math.round(x/3)*3;y=Math.round(y/3)*3;if(!valid(sc,obj,x,y)){sc.say('Blocked. Choose another spot.');return false;}
 Object.assign(obj,{x,y,stored:false,wall:WALL.has(obj.i),...bounds(sc,obj.i)});placing=null;cleanGhost();store(sc);sc.drawEquipment();sc.refresh?.();sc.say(NAMES[obj.i]+' placed and saved.');return true}
function iconFor(sc,i,x,y,w=36,h=32,parent=sc.furniturePanel){let key=ART[i];if(!sc.textures.exists(key))return;const im=sc.add.image(x,y,key).setDisplaySize(w,h).setOrigin(.5);parent.add(im)}
function buy(sc,i){if(count(sc,i)>=3){sc.say('Maximum three of each type.');return}if(sc.saveData.money<PRICE[i]){sc.say('Not enough funds.');return}sc.saveData.money-=PRICE[i];
 if(!sc.saveData.ownedGear?.[i]){sc.saveData.ownedGear??=[];sc.saveData.ownedGear[i]=true;sc.saveData.gearStored??=[];sc.saveData.gearStored[i]=true;sc.persist();sc.refresh();sc.beginGearPlacement(i)}
 else{const obj={id:'gear-'+Date.now()+'-'+Math.random().toString(36).slice(2,6),i,stored:true,x:WALL.has(i)?250:260,y:WALL.has(i)?45:200,wall:WALL.has(i)};copies(sc).push(obj);store(sc);sc.refresh();beginPlace(sc,obj)}
}
function shop(sc,page=0){if(sc.running||sc.isPlacing())return;if(sc.gymLevel()!==1)return sc.__nativeGearShop();const ids=Object.keys(NAMES).map(Number);const pages=Math.max(1,Math.ceil(ids.length/4));page=Math.max(0,Math.min(page,pages-1));
 sc.menuShell('TRAINING GEAR','EQUIPMENT  |  CLASS STAT BONUSES  |  MAX 3 EACH',()=>sc.openBuildHub());
 ids.slice(page*4,page*4+4).forEach((i,n)=>{let x=84+n%2*161,y=76+Math.floor(n/2)*70,owned=count(sc,i);
  const bg=sc.add.rectangle(x,y,149,65,0x294b52).setOrigin(0).setStrokeStyle(1,0x607c7d);sc.furniturePanel.add(bg);
  iconFor(sc,i,x+25,y+24,40,34);
  sc.furniturePanel.add(sc.add.text(x+51,y+8,NAMES[i].toUpperCase(),{fontFamily:'Arial',fontSize:'11px',fontStyle:'bold',color:'#f4e8ce',wordWrap:{width:93}}));
  sc.furniturePanel.add(sc.add.text(x+51,y+31,'+1 '+STAT_NAME[STAT[i]],{fontFamily:'Arial',fontSize:'9px',color:'#dfcf91'}));
  button(sc,'BUY $'+PRICE[i]+'  '+owned+'/3',x+7,y+46,135,17,()=>buy(sc,i),owned>=3||sc.saveData.money<PRICE[i]);
 });
 button(sc,'PREV',84,216,85,24,()=>shop(sc,page-1),page===0);button(sc,'PAGE '+(page+1)+'/'+pages,175,216,123,24,()=>{},true);button(sc,'NEXT',307,216,87,24,()=>shop(sc,page+1),page===pages-1);
}
function allOwned(sc){const arr=[];for(let i of Object.keys(NAMES).map(Number)){
 if(sc.saveData.ownedGear?.[i])arr.push({i,original:true,stored:!!sc.saveData.gearStored?.[i],id:'base-'+i});}
 for(const obj of copies(sc))if(NAMES[obj.i])arr.push(obj);return arr}
function inventory(sc,page=0){const items=allOwned(sc),pages=Math.max(1,Math.ceil(items.length/4));page=Math.max(0,Math.min(page,pages-1));sc.menuShell('TRAINING GEAR / INVENTORY','MOVE, STORE OR SELL  |  ALL COPIES',()=>sc.openFurniture('inventory'));
 items.slice(page*4,page*4+4).forEach((obj,n)=>{const y=81+n*33,i=obj.i;iconFor(sc,i,96,y+13,23,25);
  button(sc,NAMES[i].slice(0,15),114,y,104,28,()=>{},true);
  button(sc,obj.stored?'PLACE':'MOVE',223,y,66,28,()=>move(sc,obj));
  button(sc,'STORE',294,y,49,28,()=>{if(obj.original){sc.saveData.gearStored[i]=true;sc.persist()}else{obj.stored=true;store(sc)}sc.drawEquipment();inventory(sc,page)},obj.stored);
  button(sc,'SELL',348,y,46,28,()=>sell(sc,obj,page));
 });
 if(!items.length)button(sc,'NO EQUIPMENT OWNED',84,123,310,34,()=>{},true);
 button(sc,'PREV',84,216,85,25,()=>inventory(sc,page-1),page===0);button(sc,'PAGE '+(page+1)+'/'+pages,176,216,123,25,()=>{},true);button(sc,'NEXT',308,216,86,25,()=>inventory(sc,page+1),page===pages-1);
}
function move(sc,obj){if(obj.original)sc.beginGearPlacement(obj.i);else beginPlace(sc,obj)}
function sell(sc,obj,page){if(obj.original){sc.saveData.ownedGear[obj.i]=false;sc.saveData.gearStored[obj.i]=true;sc.saveData.money+=Math.floor(PRICE[obj.i]/2);sc.persist()}else{const arr=copies(sc);arr.splice(arr.indexOf(obj),1);sc.saveData.money+=Math.floor(PRICE[obj.i]/2);store(sc)}sc.refresh();sc.drawEquipment();inventory(sc,page)}
function details(sc,obj){const i=obj.i;sc.menuShell(NAMES[i].toUpperCase(),'EQUIPMENT  |  +1 '+STAT_NAME[STAT[i]],()=>sc.closePanel());iconFor(sc,i,239,105,65,58);
 button(sc,'USE EQUIPMENT',84,148,310,31,()=>{sc.closePanel();sc.coachActivity={pose:POSE[i]||'stretch',remaining:1.5};sc.say('Training with '+NAMES[i]+'.')});
 button(sc,'MOVE',84,189,148,28,()=>move(sc,obj));button(sc,'STORE',244,189,150,28,()=>{if(obj.original){sc.saveData.gearStored[i]=true;sc.persist()}else{obj.stored=true;store(sc)}sc.drawEquipment();sc.closePanel()});
}
function approach(sc,obj){if(sc.running||sc.isPlacing()||sc.furniturePanel.visible||sc.rosterPanel.visible)return;const b=bounds(sc,obj.i),player=sc.player;
 const dst=[{x:obj.x,y:obj.y+b.ry+18},{x:obj.x-b.rx-16,y:obj.y},{x:obj.x+b.rx+16,y:obj.y},{x:obj.x,y:obj.y-b.ry-16}].filter(p=>sc.canStand(p.x,p.y));dst.sort((a,b)=>Math.hypot(a.x-player.x,a.y-player.y)-Math.hypot(b.x-player.x,b.y-player.y));
 if(Math.hypot(player.x-obj.x,player.y-obj.y)<46){details(sc,obj);return}
 for(const p of dst){const route=sc.playerRoute(p,true);if(route.length){sc.clearIntent();sc.route=route;sc.__ccExtraApproach=obj;sc.say('Walking to '+NAMES[obj.i]+'.');return}}
 sc.say('No clear path to equipment.');
}
function drawExtras(sc){if(sc.gymLevel()!==1)return;sc.stations=sc.stations.filter(st=>!String(st.id||'').startsWith('copy-'));
 for(const obj of copies(sc)){if(obj.stored||!NAMES[obj.i])continue;const key=ART[obj.i],wall=WALL.has(obj.i),b=bounds(sc,obj.i),sz=spriteSize(sc,obj.i);
  if(sc.textures.exists(key)){const im=sc.add.image(obj.x,obj.y,key).setDisplaySize(sz.w,sz.h).setOrigin(.5,wall?.5:1).setDepth(wall?2:10+obj.y/100-.035);sc.worldFixtures.push(im)}
  if(!wall){sc.stations.push({x:obj.x,y:obj.y,rx:b.rx,ry:b.ry,id:'copy-'+obj.id,pose:POSE[obj.i]||'rest'});const hit=sc.add.zone(obj.x,obj.y-sz.h/2,sz.w+8,sz.h+8).setDepth(18).setInteractive({useHandCursor:true});hit.on('pointerdown',(p,lx,ly,e)=>{e.stopPropagation();approach(sc,obj)});sc.worldFixtures.push(hit)}
 }
}
function createDoors(sc){if(sc.__ccDoorControls||sc.gymLevel()!==1||!sc.__ccL1Objects)return;sc.__ccDoorControls=[];
 for(const [name,x,y,w,h] of [['Garage door',161,59,81,67],['Side door',315,62,28,63]]){const z=sc.add.zone(x,y,w,h).setDepth(20).setInteractive({useHandCursor:true});z.on('pointerover',()=>{if(!sc.furniturePanel.visible&&!sc.isPlacing())sc.say(name+': click to '+(sc.dayPhase()==='opening'?'open gym':sc.dayPhase()==='open'?'close gym':'start next day')+'.')});z.on('pointerdown',(p,lx,ly,e)=>{e.stopPropagation();if(sc.furniturePanel.visible||sc.rosterPanel.visible||sc.isPlacing())return;sc.advanceGymPhase()});sc.__ccDoorControls.push(z)}
}
function restoreStudentPositions(sc){const save=sc.saveData.ccSavedPositions;if(!save||save.day!==sc.saveData.day)return;
 if(save.coach&&Number.isFinite(save.coach.x)&&sc.canStand(save.coach.x,save.coach.y)){sc.player.setPosition(save.coach.x,save.coach.y);sc.coach.place(save.coach.x,save.coach.y)}
 for(const st of sc.students){const p=save.students?.[st.name];if(!st.actor||!p||!Number.isFinite(p.x)||!sc.canStand(p.x,p.y))continue;st.x=p.x;st.y=p.y;st.routine=sc.idleRoutine(st,1);st.actor.place(st.x,st.y)}
}
function snapshot(sc){if(!sc||!sc.saveData||!sc.player||!sc.students)return;sc.saveData.ccSavedPositions={day:sc.saveData.day,coach:{x:sc.player.x,y:sc.player.y},students:Object.fromEntries(sc.students.map(st=>[st.name,{x:st.x,y:st.y}]))};sc.saveData.roomState??={};sc.saveData.roomState.playerPositions??={};sc.saveData.roomState.playerPositions.main={x:sc.player.x,y:sc.player.y};sc.persist()}
function attach(sc){if(sc.__ccNov13Bound)return;sc.__ccNov13Bound=true;
 try{const native=Array.isArray(sc.saveData.extraGear)?sc.saveData.extraGear:[],raw=localStorage.getItem(STORAGE);sc.saveData.extraGear=raw?JSON.parse(raw):native;if(!Array.isArray(sc.saveData.extraGear))sc.saveData.extraGear=native;sc.saveData.extraGear=sc.saveData.extraGear.filter(o=>NAMES[o.i])}catch{sc.saveData.extraGear=Array.isArray(sc.saveData.extraGear)?sc.saveData.extraGear.filter(o=>NAMES[o.i]):[]}
 sc.__nativeGearShop=sc.openGearShop.bind(sc);sc.openGearShop=()=>shop(sc,0);
 sc.__nativeGearInventory=sc.openInventoryCategory.bind(sc);sc.openInventoryCategory=kind=>kind==='gear'?inventory(sc,0):sc.__nativeGearInventory(kind);
 const oldDraw=sc.drawEquipment.bind(sc);sc.drawEquipment=function(...args){const r=oldDraw(...args);drawExtras(sc);return r};
 if(window.__ccNov13Assets){for(const [key,src] of Object.entries(window.__ccNov13Assets)){if(sc.textures.exists(key))continue;const img=new Image();img.onload=()=>{if(!sc.textures.exists(key)){sc.textures.addImage(key,img);if(sc.sys.isActive())sc.drawEquipment()}};img.src=src}}
 restoreStudentPositions(sc);sc.drawEquipment();createDoors(sc);
 const onUpdate=()=>{if(!sc.sys.isActive())return;if(!sc.__ccDoorControls)createDoors(sc);const o=sc.__ccExtraApproach;if(o&&Math.hypot(sc.player.x-o.x,sc.player.y-o.y)<46){sc.__ccExtraApproach=null;sc.route=[];details(sc,o)}};
 sc.events.on('update',onUpdate);
 sc.events.once('shutdown',()=>{snapshot(sc);sc.events.off('update',onUpdate);sc.__ccNov13Bound=false;sc.__ccDoorControls=null;sc.__ccExtraApproach=null;if(placing){placing=null;cleanGhost()}});
}
setInterval(()=>{const sc=scene();if(sc){attach(sc);if(sc.sys.isActive()&&!placing&&sc.saveData?.day!=null)snapshot(sc)}},1500);
const onCanvas=e=>e.target===window.CC_GAME?.canvas;
document.addEventListener('pointerdown',e=>{if(!placing||!onCanvas(e))return;const sc=scene();if(!sc)return;const r=window.CC_GAME.canvas.getBoundingClientRect();placeAt(sc,(e.clientX-r.left)*480/r.width,(e.clientY-r.top)*330/r.height);e.preventDefault();e.stopImmediatePropagation()},true);
document.addEventListener('pointermove',e=>{if(!placing||!ghost||!onCanvas(e))return;const sc=scene();if(!sc)return;const r=window.CC_GAME.canvas.getBoundingClientRect(),x=(e.clientX-r.left)*480/r.width,y=(e.clientY-r.top)*330/r.height,ok=valid(sc,placing.obj,x,y);ghost.setPosition(x,y).setFillStyle(ok?0x74c6a6:0xeb7b78,.25).setStrokeStyle(1,ok?0xdff2d2:0xffadad)},true);
document.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(!placing)return;if(e.key==='Escape'){cancel();e.preventDefault();e.stopImmediatePropagation()}else if(e.key==='Enter'){const sc=scene();placeAt(sc,ghost?.x||placing.obj.x,ghost?.y||placing.obj.y);e.preventDefault();e.stopImmediatePropagation()}},true);
window.addEventListener('pagehide',()=>snapshot(scene()));document.addEventListener('visibilitychange',()=>{if(document.hidden)snapshot(scene())});
})();
</script>
</body></html>
